items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-10-14
items.q: Captain used to enjoy seeing me... he gave me a, told everybody on the boat, anything you want to give him, any concession stand, he said, you don't pay for nothing on this boat.

ctx.x: No, I used to box at school in the middle of it. When I, Captain used to enjoy seeing me, you know, getting nine with them rouserbots, you know, and carry the stave. I mean, he gave me a, told everybody on the boat, anything you want to give him, any concession stand, he said, you don't pay for nothing on this boat. He said, that's a terrible youngster. And then we'd play at night, we'd play excursions from Columbia, Columbia, Mississippi, you know, and, I mean, Louisiana, and up around Arkansas. And we'd get to…
Just by yourself on clarinet, or?
